title: 서북도서방위사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Emergency Military Measures)
(1) Where emergency military measures or emergency measures in response to a disaster are necessary, the Commander may temporarily command and supervise units in the areas of responsibility other than units under the Command's jurisdiction (hereinafter referred to as "other units").
(2) Where the Commander has temporarily commanded and supervised other units under paragraph (1), the Commander shall, without delay, report the circumstances to the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the Chief of Naval Operations and notify the superior commanders of those other units.
